anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: John's leather belt around the loin.
Put to death the members — possible.

choices.why: Hedge on why John wore leather.

pass_a_gloss: To this perhaps word John the Baptist too, since he was perfect, had a leathern belt about his loin, it being shown that he has put to death there all his seed-motion, the leather showing deadness, that the deadness filled his whole nature.
pass_b_english: Perhaps for this reason John the Baptist too, since he was perfect, had a leather belt around his loin — it being shown that he had put to death there all his seed-motion. The leather shows deadness: deadness had filled his whole nature.
source_text: Τούτῳ τάχα τῷ λογῷ καὶ Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτιστής, ἐπεὶ τέλ[ε]ιος ἦν, εἶχεν ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ, δηλουμένου ὅτι νενέκρωκεν ἐκεῖ πᾶσαν τὴν κίνησιν αὐτοῦ τὴν σπερματικήν, τοῦ δέρματος νεκρότητα δηλοῦντος ὅτι ἡ νεκρότης ὅλην αὐτοῦ περιέ[π]λησεν τὴν φύσιν.
